searchText: just as an fyi, starting to look at removing the deprecated teku rest api's that aren't in line with the standard. I've flagged it in a few places, not sure how to contact eth2stats exactly, they may be interested? https://github.com/ConsenSys/teku/pull/3168 Anyone here from eth2stats? Eth2stats was originally created by Alethio, but they stopped. The eth2stats dash, server and client are open source though. And I'm maintaining the stats-client with updates for beacon client compatibility. However, no changes necessary here I think. Simply change the type flag from "teku" to "v1" to use eth2stats with a compliant v1 API ok cool that's not so bad. just making sure i spread that pr around a bit, because anyone using deprecated api will want to know https://github.com/alethio/eth2stats-client If it doesn't work please open an issue here and I'll look into it <@!680234424037670912> would be good to have the standard API fully implemented beforehand, it makes life difficult otherwise its basically implemented, just a couple of random options like search by parent root this is basically wrapping up the feature really want them gone before we do a RC Is it all merged? a couple of pool posts arent but the rest is Okay, I have some tools that use the standard API so will try to run them against current master of teku and see how they go. Where would be best to talk about any issues I find, or would you rather me just raise them on the github? happy to get github issues, theres a couple we've implemented unmerged api PR's , hoping they mostly finish before i have to implement more unmerged PR's

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: Eth2stats was originally created by Alethio, but they stopped. The eth2stats dash, server and client are open source though. And I'm maintaining the stats-client with updates for beacon client compatibility. However, no changes necessary here I think. Simply change the type flag from "teku" to "v1" to use eth2stats with a compliant v1 API
